caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rectangular shape and a hinged lid. The chest is primarily colored in shades of brown, suggesting a natural wood material. The front of the chest features two decorative panels, each with a symmetrical, arch-shaped design. Within each arch, there are floral motifs with greenish accents, and the arches are flanked by stylized pilasters. The panels are divided by a central section that includes a small, diamond-shaped keyhole. The base of the chest has a molding detail and stands on four short bracket feet. The right and left edges of the chest also include the same green-accented vertical elements as seen on the front. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and the artist’s name “FRANCES LICHTEN” is inscribed on the lower left.
title: Pa. German Dower Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
